security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' asset: data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Show your clicks and shortcuts on screen.
bundle.longDescription: Glassview draws a ripple where you click and shows the shortcuts you press, so viewers of a screen recording or live demo can follow along. It runs locally and never shows typed text unless you ask it to.
